label: PF Backlog 177
title: Context overflow: split-by-size + model-upgrade + map-reduce (never lose content, one coherent file)
body: llm_client._call_llm_chunked hardened: (1) SPLIT-BY-SIZE — an artifact larger than the per-chunk budget is split into line-bounded pieces, so a single huge incoming artifact still fits; (2) MODEL-UPGRADE — if the whole prompt exceeds the window, try a larger-window model in the tier for a single call; (3) MAP-REDUCE — each chunk yields a dense DIGEST (never the final artifact), then ONE reduce call produces the single coherent artifact, replacing the old naive concat (which would have produced a mangled multi-doc file); hierarchical digest-compression if the reduce input is still too big. Verified: 1.98M-char input, 50k window -> 13 chunks (all <= window), 13 map + 1 reduce, final = single reduce output, no loss.
